Umicore SA Launches New Catalyst Product Amidst Rising Demand in Green Technologies

Brussels—Umicore SA, a leading name in Belgium’s chemicals sector, announced the launch of its latest emissions-reducing catalyst product at a ceremony in its Hoboken facility on Tuesday. The product, designed for industrial applications such as chemical processing and power generation, is set to bolster the company’s offering in the rapidly growing field of sustainable technologies.

The new catalyst, developed after three years of research and development, aims to help manufacturers lower emissions of nitrogen oxides and volatile organic compounds. The launch comes as regulatory pressures mount across the European Union, with the European Chemicals Agency introducing stricter emissions standards for several industries earlier this year.

Marc Grynberg, CEO of Umicore SA, emphasized the strategic importance of the product: “Our new catalyst technology strengthens Umicore’s position as a partner of choice for companies seeking cleaner, more efficient industrial solutions. We are committed to supporting our customers’ ambitions to meet evolving environmental standards.”

According to the Belgian Chemicals Federation, demand for emissions-reducing technologies has risen by 15% in the past year. Industry analysts see Umicore’s move as timely, with the company’s expertise in catalyst development giving it a competitive edge. “Umicore’s focus on R&D and sustainability aligns well with global trends,” said Sophie Meyers, a chemicals sector analyst at the Brussels-based consultancy InnoStrat. “This launch could open new market opportunities, especially as industries accelerate their green transition.”

Umicore reported that the new product would be available to customers worldwide starting next quarter. The company also plans to invest in expanding its production capacity in Belgium to meet anticipated demand.
